purpose: Choose one or several pressed formatting tools, and describe standalone Toggle from the same native source family.
avoid: Pressed state, single selection and multiple selection are separate contracts.
basis: Native source page 73:2902 (Toggle & Toggle Group), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: ToggleGroup value/defaultValue are arrays even when multiple=false. multiple=false permits one pressed item and pressing it again clears the array; multiple=true toggles independent items. Items are native buttons aria-pressed. Group disabled and item disabled suppress changes; group size/variant context overrides item appearance when set, spacing defaults2. Standalone Toggle has pressed/defaultPressed boolean and onPressedChange(pressed,eventDetails), disabled, variant default|outline and size default|sm|lg. It is included from its own pinned source module, not lost as an unindexed dependency.
keyboardAndFocus: Native Enter/Space activates a toggle. ToggleGroup source composite uses horizontal arrows, Home/End and loopFocus=true by default; focus navigation alone does not press a toggle. IMPORTANT pinned wrapper limitation: orientation is consumed for visual/data layout and not forwarded to ToggleGroupPrimitive, so a requested vertical layout does not establish vertical primitive keyboard orientation. This reference uses horizontal groups and records the actual limitation instead of claiming vertical parity. Standalone Toggle has normal native Tab order.
referenceDecision: Stable actual item values, concrete visible labels and error/help relations are supplied by the caller. Use horizontal Tabs/ToggleGroup and array Slider values explicitly; upstream wrapper limitations are described, not hidden by altering frozen code.
